runtimeMapping.normal: One Physical ground target; Attack .433, ASPD clock uncapped.
runtimeMapping.substitute: Own source attributes, zero block, Physical melee versus ground/air, x-4 range, Attack_B .433. No Bena sanctuary/Arts projectile/stat swap.
runtimeMapping.entrance: Owner Die_2 then Start_B, one Arts ground-only x-4 pulse at Start_B .267. Token Start .267 followed by original0.2s talent buff before one pulse.
runtimeMapping.S1: All10 ranks; selected atk_scale on next attack; accepted output bridge charges maxHP hp_ratio PURE/NORMAL without mitigation/SP, including shield-zero but excluding dodge/cancel.
runtimeMapping.S2: All10 ranks; undeadable currentHP hp_ratio cost, separate source-token attributes and atk buff; random free legal surrounding melee tile. No DP or deployment slot. Owner buff finish/interruption kills shadows.
runtimeMapping.return: Die_B then Start, full heal, zero block through transition, ordinary range/stats restored on completion, mode1 duration20 after local birth completion.

verificationLimits: No frame-for-frame parity, module behavior or native particle rendering. Native controller scheduler, immediate buff priority and ParallelAbility completion order are unavailable; local fixed-step ordering is bounded and tested.

Owner full-heal transition begins immediately, uses1s originalFront outgoing death plus1s originalselected-facing birth. Back has no outgoing death clip. Mode1 countdown starts on local SwitchEnd after birth; native FSM completion timing is unavailable.

Native token Born dispatch timing is unavailable: local originalStart attack event .267 plus literal0.2s talent buff gates burst; Start completion1s gates normal attacks. Original flags do not grant transition invulnerability to the S2 token.

Native spawn selector filterType7 enum/priority has not been recovered. Local selection uniformly samples free MELEE/ALL, passable surrounding x-4 tiles after occupancy/build checks; does not invent nearest-enemy priority. Spawn initial facing RIGHT, then sourcefaceToTarget attacks select facing; no inherited owner direction.

S1 ON_OUTPUT_DAMAGE uses accepted damaged callback; shield-zero counts, cancelled/dodged/element accumulation excluded, synchronous self-cost after victim resolution avoids recursion. Native callback priority and interruption/SP refund behavior are unavailable.

Source substitute trait atk/maxHP modifiers are0; retain own selected build attributes and durable bonuses. S2 token uses independent selected source phase/level/potential talent, no owner trust/potential stat bonus.
